CustomField.description: When the respondent's session on a new form began. Use it, not Created Date, for time-to-complete and abandonment reports: with deferred saves or autosave off, the record can be created well after the respondent started. Set once and never changed by resume, Save Progress, autosave or submit. Prefill templates are never stamped, and a submission seeded from a prefill template does not inherit the value.
CustomField.label: Form Start Date Time
